title: Student Assistant - DTU Compute, DTU
description_md:
We are looking for a student to help develop and test AI-supported online mathematics tutorials using RAG and Quarto.

You will:

* develop and test RAG-based support for Quarto mathematics tutorials
* work with course notes in PDF/Markdown and improve retrieval and AI responses
* test the solution on new MAT1 material and InterMat
